source_state: Frozen modified-working-tree candidate; full release integration is a separate result.
environment: Single managed-cloud Chromium run with a disposable local profile while other checks were active concurrently.
scope: Only the 10,000-task workspace run below, not the complete 38-program release suite.

dataset.notes: Synthetic tasks with projects, tags, descriptions and partially completed subtasks.

methodology.timings: Elapsed milliseconds around scripted operations, including browser interaction and driver work, not pure rendering CPU time.
methodology.comparison: Concurrent single cloud observation, not a controlled speed comparison with earlier releases or the different calendar-scale dataset.
methodology.memory: Browser heap and process RSS were not measured. File byte counts are not memory usage.
methodology.limits: No real-device, system-notification, remote-CI or deployed-host result is established. Manual/batch modes still render full matching data.

verification: Downloaded JSON and the pre-import safety snapshot match canonical full-field SHA-256 task signatures.
Replacement import, deletion and confirmed checkpoint restoration preserve task/subtask fields.
The immediately replaced state remains in recovery history.
Timeline paging, far-end search and initial-page reset preserve task data.
